payload.claim: The "Notes for the agent" prose reminder lists em dash, semicolon, contraction, perfect tense, filler word, and sentence-over-25-words, but omits the prose gate's separate "hedge" rule (should/may/might), one of WORD_RULES in .saffron/gates/prose.py. This costs nothing since the same omission already exists in the predecessor spec SA-0372, and it is advisory text rather than acceptance text.
